name: Undaunted Apparel
old_description: This product has multiple variants. The options may be chosen on the product page
about:
Undaunted Apparel operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, and has been active since 2012. The company began as a private brand rooted in themes of freedom and veteran support, founded by a group of individuals who wanted to honor military service and conservation causes. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business evolved from selling its own labeled hoodies, tees, and headwear into a contract decoration service for other companies and organizations. It runs a web-based design portal that lets customers upload artwork, choose from a library of graphics, and order custom-printed garments on demand. The product line includes pullover hoodies, short- and long-sleeve T-shirts, hats, and challenge coins, sourced as blanks and decorated in-house or through partner facilities. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Clients range from corporate buyers ordering bulk logo wear — such as a Las Vegas company that placed a large T-shirt order — to nonprofit groups like Pedaling Against Poaching, veteran organizations, and motorsports teams including GRR and Reif Racing. The company also outfits individual athletes and outdoor enthusiasts through its "Teams" program, which spans animal-rights advocates, rescue squads, and competitive riders.

The founders state that the venture expanded into contract work after repeated requests from other brands asking how and where they produced their own merchandise. That demand led to a service model focused on helping partners bring products to market, while the original mission — supporting veterans, fighting poaching, and promoting a "Wear What Matters" ethos — remains central to the brand identity.
